about: P263 search corpus: queries mapped to the inventory rows a contestant wants (00-search.md, Evaluation). Library Checker problems come from 00-Guidelines/Ledgers/library-checker-coverage.json at test time.

sources.cp: cp-algorithms article titles, https://cp-algorithms.com/navigation.html, retrieved 2026-11-07; every title compared byte by byte with the raw page
sources.oi: OI Wiki page slugs (query: the slug with / and - as spaces), mkdocs.yml nav of github.com/OI-wiki/OI-wiki, retrieved 2026-11-07; every slug compared byte by byte with the raw nav
sources.abbr: contest abbreviations collected by the P263 @researcher sweep (00-search.md, Sources)
sources.simple: short everyday concept queries mapped to the simplest row providing them (implemented before planned, lower tier first, then the most elementary), from the inventories alone; P263 review, 2026-11-07
sources.py: `python <concept>` queries mapped to the 08-Python module providing the concept, from the inventories alone; P263 review, 2026-11-07
sources.zh: the same OI Wiki pages' Chinese nav titles (mkdocs.yml); P263 adds each title to the aliases of its target rows that have an evidence document (outside five pairs where the page names a helper or another structure of its row), so zh checks those aliases and stays outside the tuning objective (00-search.md, Evaluation)
sources.zhs: everyday Simplified Chinese concept queries mapped by the `simple` rule, written by a subagent from the inventories alone, without the search code, the aliases or this corpus; P263 follow-up, 2026-11-07
sources.zht: Traditional Chinese queries in Taiwan and Hong Kong usage, half on the zhs concepts and half on others, same rule and writer as zhs; P263 follow-up, 2026-11-07
